player_prompt.intro:
Am  Player {player_id} Indian Poker khelāre ṭhāklena.
- 52-ti kaṛḍa deck; aṃ ṣaḍe bāleka ṛīṛia kaṛḍa ḍhaka.
- Prati ṭhāku {ante} chip ṭhāklena, {max_rounds} ṭhāku ṭoṭal.
- Juṛwalā ṭhāk: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ṭhāklena aṃ ṣaḍe chip ṣaṅkhyā ṭoṭal ṭhāklena.)
- Uḍḍa ḍhaka kaṛḍa ṭhāklena ṣoḍauna ṭhāklena.
